semantics.request_refusals: InvalidArgument for 0 or more than 32 items, empty, >64-byte, non-UTF-8 or repeated item_id, invalid line range, output_bytes 0 or > 2 MiB; OutOfScope when the session is bound to another workspace; ResourceExhausted for a released reservation, no handles, or a reservation smaller than the result store; all before any read or allocation
semantics.per_item_errors: authorization and read errors map to ErrorInfo with errors.wireCode and defaultRetryable; other items are unaffected
semantics.order: items keep input order; item ids, paths, lines and text are copied into the result arena
semantics.dedupe_merge: same path, write_intent and consistency with overlapping or touching ranges share one union read of at most 5,000 lines; each item takes its own lines and applies its own output_bytes, matching a single read
semantics.shared_output: reservation.output is the batch text cap; reads are granted output in item order; an item whose read was shortened because the grant was smaller than its own output_bytes fails with E_OUTPUT_BUDGET; unused grant returns to the pool
semantics.concurrency: min(Caps.max_concurrency, reads, reservation.fd) workers; a read starts only when its memory (jobBytes) fits what the store leaves of the reservation and, for a partial output grant, when no earlier read is running; results do not depend on concurrency
semantics.memory: one store allocation sized by storeCharge; per read one scratch chunk then one result block (T04 Reader); a read's memory returns to the pool only after it is freed
semantics.cancellation: Batcher.cancel is checked before dispatching each read and by the reader per chunk; Cancelled is returned after all reads finish and the arena is freed
semantics.batch_status: complete only when every item is complete; truncated when any item is truncated or failed with E_OUTPUT_BUDGET; coverage.skipped counts failed items; reasons name shared-budget refusals and item errors
semantics.projection: output_bytes bounds the serialized data payload (= meta.returned_bytes); whole lines, paths or search files are dropped from the end, batch items that do not fit are replaced by E_OUTPUT_BUDGET item errors; truncation sets complete=false and adds a reason; a payload that cannot hold its first entry is OutputBudgetExceeded and the caller sends failure(); workspace_id is '<registry hex>:<incarnation hex>', file_id is '<device>:<inode>'

exports: zcr_batch (src/batch/read.zig): Caps, BatchFault, JobEvent, Report, Batcher{init, batchRead (core.BatchReadFn), report, cancel, fault}, plannedCost, storeCharge, jobBytes, max_item_id_bytes, reason_output_refused, reason_item_errors

zcr_projection (src/protocol/projection.zig): Envelope, Data{read, batch_read, files, search}, FilesData, SearchData, Response, Error, success, failure, bufferBytes, failureBufferBytes, max_request_id_bytes, reason_output_budget, message_item_output_budget
limitations: deadline_ms is carried but not enforced (the T04 reader does not enforce it either); a deadline must be expressed through Batcher.cancel
an item that starts after the first line of a merged union that alone exceeds all members' output_bytes fails with E_OUTPUT_BUDGET, where a single read of that item might succeed
the result store reserves min(sum of requested lines, text cap) line records, which over-reserves for long lines
whether reads ran in parallel depends on std.Io.Group.concurrent; peak concurrency is recorded, latency is not measured (docs/12 batch 8x small read p95 target is T21)
Report.output_refused counts only shared-pool refusals, not items whose first line exceeds their own output_bytes
ReadFault hooks on a shared Reader are not thread-safe; tests that use them run with max_concurrency 1
projection does not implement structured_compat or coverage.filters; envelope bytes are not counted in output_bytes
Linux and Intel macOS are cross-compiled only
